t1.title: Mapping accuracy (T1): ATE RMSE (m), lower is better
t1.note: Cells: mean ATE over the dataset's sequences. Overall: ATE / ground-truth path length, averaged over each dataset's sequences, then over the three datasets (a method missing a dataset has no overall value). Scale error (monocular rows): how far the trajectory's scale is from metric, max(s, 1/s) - 1 for the scale s of a Sim(3) fit to the ground truth; the median over each dataset's finished sequences, averaged over the three datasets. Monocular systems without metric input are scored after Sim(3) alignment, so their ATE does not include this error; the others are scored with SE(3).
